# QR Snap

> Android QR and barcode app: scan, create, check links, export, backup, share, and run a small Point of Sale. Data stays on the device.

QR Snap is a Flutter app from Ars Technology (package com.ars.qr_snap). You scan QR codes and barcodes with the camera or from gallery images, generate 14+ code types, and act on the result (open, call, save contact, add event, copy, share). URL safety checks and unlimited email-domain (MX) validation sit on the scan result. Lifetime Unlock adds gallery batch scan, local backup and restore, export, share, and on-device Point of Sale. URL credit packs add extra safety checks.

## What QR Snap includes

- Live camera scan and scan from gallery
- Camera batch scan (free); gallery batch scan (Lifetime Unlock)
- Fast recognition for QR and many barcode formats
- Generate URL, text, email, phone, SMS, Wi-Fi, vCard, calendar, location, social, product barcodes
- Result actions: open link, call, SMS, email, save contact, add event, maps, copy, share, product lookup
- URL link safety check (Google Web Risk + pattern checks; 5 free per day)
- Unlimited email domain (MX) validation for everyone
- History, favorites, folders, smart filters; local storage only
- Export: CSV, JSON, image ZIP, parsed text as shown in-app (Lifetime)
- Local backup and restore (Lifetime)
- Share to other apps (Lifetime)
- Point of Sale: inventory, scan-to-cart, sales history, receipts (Lifetime)
- Flexible pricing: Free, Lifetime Unlock ($9.99 one-time), URL packs ($0.99 / $2.99 / $4.99)

## Scanning

- Live camera scan for QR codes and barcodes
- Scan from gallery images
- Batch from camera: free
- Batch from gallery: Lifetime Unlock
- Fast recognition across QR and common barcode formats (EAN, UPC, Code 128, Code 39, ITF, and more)

## Generation (14+ types)

- URL, text, email, phone, SMS
- Wi-Fi credentials
- Contact / vCard
- Calendar events
- Location / geo
- Social profiles
- Product / custom barcodes (EAN, ISBN, and related formats as supported in-app)
- Preview, custom icons, history and favorites

## URL safety and email checks

- URL check: pattern checks plus Google Web Risk (primary)
- Optional VirusTotal enrichment only when commercially enabled
- 5 URL checks per day for every install (Free and Lifetime)
- Extra checks via rewarded ads (+2) or credit packs (30 / 100 / 250)
- Failed or inconclusive checks do not consume credits
- Email MX validation is unlimited and does not use URL credits
- Results: safe, risk, or unavailable, in plain language

## Export, backup, restore, share (Lifetime Unlock)

- Export CSV, JSON, image ZIP, and parsed text as shown in-app
- Local backup and restore on the device
- Share flows to other apps
- No cloud sync of codes

## Point of Sale (Lifetime Unlock)

- Local shop / product inventory
- Scan-to-cart checkout
- Sales history and reports
- Receipt PDF / thermal printer setup where the platform allows
- POS data stays on the device; backup uses Lifetime tools
- The user is responsible for tax and receipt rules in their jurisdiction

## Pricing

### Free
- Price: $0
- Scan and generate, history, favorites, folders
- Ads (banner and occasional interstitial)
- 5 URL safety checks per day
- Unlimited email domain checks
- Rewarded ads: +2 URL checks (max 2 ads / 24h, 15-minute cooldown)

### Lifetime Unlock
- Price: $9.99 one-time (SKU: qrsnap_lifetime_unlock)
- Ads removed permanently
- Gallery batch scan
- Backup, restore, export, share
- Point of Sale
- Still 5 URL checks per day (buy packs for more)
- Restores with the same store account on the Plans screen

### URL Credit Packs (consumables, never expire on that install)
- Starter: $0.99 for 30 checks (qrsnap_url_credits_30)
- Standard: $2.99 for 100 checks (qrsnap_url_credits_100)
- Value: $4.99 for 250 checks (qrsnap_url_credits_250)
- Cannot be restored after uninstall, app-data clear, or a new device

Credit order: free daily, then rewarded bonus, then purchased credits.

Play Store / App Store localized prices are authoritative.

## Privacy

- No account required
- Anonymous installation ID for entitlements and the credit wallet
- History and created codes stay on the device (Hive)
- No cloud sync
- For a URL check, only what is needed for the check is sent to the Cloudflare Worker backend
- No sale of scan contents for advertising profiles
